newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. Stealth planes arrive in Kuwait -- source.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stealth planes arrive in Kuwait -- source.

text.p: A military source said eight U.S. Stealth bombers arrived in Kuwait on Friday on a mission that U.S. officials have said may involve possible action against former occupier Iraq.

The military source said by telephone the radar-evading planes had flown in from New Mexico in the United States to a military airfield in the Gulf state in the early evening after a 20-hour, non-stop flight. There were no further details.
U.S. military and other officials were unable immediately to confirm the arrival of the planes, which starred in the U.S. air campaign against Iraq in the 1991 Gulf War.

Iraq, in a fresh standoff with Washington over the expansion of a southern no-fly zone, told Kuwait on Thursday it would be committing an act of war if it allowed U.S. Stealth warplanes to use its territory for attacks on his country.
The U.S. planes were moving into position for possible bombing raids against Iraq after Iraqi forces fired a surface-to-air missile at U.S. fighters over northern Iraq on Wednesday.
